mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate (implied from PAYEMS and UNRATE) above 63% for two consecutive months signals broader labor market engagement, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Labor force participation implied > 63% for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when implied labor force participation > 63% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals improving residential demand and construction activity, which boosts materials and homebuilder equities, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
